<!-- pr-reviewer: a947b9380f45f70bc801d14110953b884d2a7444 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (the commit type / breaking-change label is being handled by the maintainer separately; the load-refusal of conflicting old projects was accepted as a maintainer decision).

No build.rs, `.github/`, script or dependency changes, so the PR was built and tested normally.

### What looks good
- One source for the work-offset word: `setup::wcs_slot(world, setup)`; `HeightReference::WorkOffset` is now a unit variant, so no per-height slot can exist in memory.
- Stamp feeds the resolved slot (`operation/params.rs:34`), so migrated stamps equal v51 stamps and a pick change stales exactly the ops with work-offset heights. Goldens and snapshots unchanged.
- `SetSetupWorkOffset` snapshots prev/next, `invert` restores; validated at construction.
- Migration (`wcs_migrate.rs`) reads slots from the DTO JSON before any world write, refuses by name, treats a v52 file carrying a slot as corrupt; MCP/JSON param input refuses a slot (`project/json.rs:29`).
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; provenance lines and a decision file present.

### Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main, clean merge)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 88 passed |
| setup_defines_wcs / setup_wcs / rotated_wcs / wcs_align | 4 / 7 / 4 / 5 passed |
| posting / fanuc_post / golden_cl / conformance | 17 / 8 / 23 / 6 passed |
| project_roundtrip / commands_undo | 68 / 32 passed |
| heights / heights_selection / setups / setup_sheet | 11 / 9 / 11 / 7 passed |
| lathe_spindle_law / mcp | 8 / 4 passed |
| app operations / ui operations | 31 / 117 passed (6 ignored) |
| ui lib (CWD crates/ui) | 286 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

### Every path that produces or displays a work-offset word (hard check)
All go through `setup::wcs_slot` / `setup::work_offset`; no second derivation found.
- Heights resolution and missing-source text: `operation/heights.rs:68,105`.
- Stamp: `operation/params.rs:34`; spindle-origin stamp `stamp.rs:125`.
- Posting: `posting.rs:676` and `wcs_context` (`posting.rs:768`) -> `posting_wcs_slot.rs:32` -> `setup::wcs_slot`; the WorkOffset/OriginX/Y/Z PARAM records come from that tuple. Rotation refusal `posting_wcs_rotation.rs:65,82` and the shared-word refusal use the same call. `operation/job.rs:242`, `spindle_law.rs:257`, `machine/mod.rs:149` use `wcs_context(world, setup)`; the params argument is gone.
- Setup sheet `setup_sheet/sections.rs:89-94` reads `setup::work_offset` (pick, else "G54 (the default)").
- Heights page row `heights_page.rs:114`, Setups page entry `setup_wcs_pick.rs:21`, viewport chip `interact.rs:798-805`: all `setup::wcs_slot`.
- Project save: `project/wire.rs:73` writes the setup's pick only; heights write `{"work_offset": {}}` (`params.rs:1415`).
- MCP: `mcp/job.rs:48` only lists the six placeable slots (not a derivation).
- `.cps` posts (assets/posts/*.cps: fanuc, fanuc-lathe, haas, mazak, sinumerik, tormach, heidenhain): each `wcsWord` is a "G54" initial value overwritten by `name === "WorkOffset"` from the engine's PARAM (e.g. fanuc.cps:238, haas.cps:204); none hard-codes the word in output. heidenhain.cps:184 reads the param and refuses non-G54 by message.
- Remaining "G54" literals are defaults/fallbacks of an already-resolved index (`posting_wcs_slot.rs:37`, `posting_wcs_rotation.rs:82`, `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:137` record default that posting overwrites) - not a separate derivation. `wcs_ui.slot` (ui) is the placement cursor for editing a slot's origin (`SetWcs`), not the program word.

### Requested before merge
None blocking.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:2927`: the status for clearing the pick still says "posts at each operation's inferred offset"; since #329 it is the G54 default. Suggest "posts at the default G54".
2. `interact.rs:800` resolves the chip's word with setup `None` (the first setup), as the viewport height planes already resolve their Z with `None` (`height_planes`). It is consistent with the plane Z, but for an op in a later setup with a different pick the viewport label and plane would follow the first setup. Pre-existing limitation of height_planes; worth its own issue.
3. `operation/params.rs:34` uses `.min(255) as u8`; harmless (slot <= 5) but a `u8::try_from(..).unwrap_or(u8::MAX)` would match the casting law.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9369577aeca813c3a44b03ec18059db4bdd78790 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one leftover "default" wording on the setup sheet, which the maintainer rule forbids. Everything else in the delta (a947b93..9369577) checks out.

**What looks good**
- `interact::shown_setup` returns the shown op's own setup, and the active setup for a draft name. The viewport chip and every height plane (clearance, hop, face top/cut, top/bottom, part, chamfer, drill/bore/thread) now use it. The only remaining first-setup fallback is `setup::effective(None)`, for an op stored with no setup. That matches what posting does, so I accept it.
- The Setups combo has a single `G54` entry (`normalized` folds unset and slot 0 together). Unset stays unset on disk, so the goldens and round-trip are unchanged (`golden_cl`, `project_roundtrip` pass).
- Heights row reads `G55  (from setup Setup2)`, or plain `G54` with no setup. Status reads `Setup2 work offset: G54`.
- `params.rs` uses `u8::try_from(..).unwrap_or(u8::MAX)`.
- The new tests assert the right things: the chip text and plane Z per op with the other setup active, the draft name resolving to the active setup, and unset/Some(0) both reading `G54`.
- The empty commit 9369577 carries the `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer (project v52).

**Local results** (merged with current origin/main, no conflicts)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| build `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | ok |
| ui `--lib` (CWD crates/ui) | 289 passed, 2 ignored |
| app setup_wcs / setup_defines_wcs / heights / heights_selection | 7 / 4 / 11 / 9 passed |
| app posting / project_roundtrip / golden_cl | 17 / 68 / 23 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings` app, ui | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/src/setup_sheet/sections.rs:89-95` still prints `program offset: G54 (the default - not picked)` for an unset setup and `(picked for this setup)` for a pick. This is the "(default)" wording the rule bans. An unset setup should read the same plain word as an explicit one, e.g. `program offset: G54`. Update the assertions at `crates/app/tests/setup_wcs.rs:283` and `:286` to match. The doc comment at `crates/app/src/setup.rs` ("the `G54` default") and `setup_wcs_pick.rs` ("Unpicked is the G54 default") are fine as developer comments.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_wcs_tests.rs:62` has the assertion message "undo restores Auto". Reword it to "undo restores the unset (G54) setup".
- `lib.rs` places `mod setup_chip_tests` after `vertex_pick_tests`. Cosmetic only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
